notes.title: HE HAS COME. AS FORETOLD IN THE ANCIENT TOMES.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45080836/ba76bb8849adb3a012feb24d749671aa6f20e808.jpg[/img]

[h1]After more than a year and a half of working on this project it is finally complete! [/h1]
We will be releasing the full version on Steam and on itch.io Feburary 14th, 2025! I'm really proud of the work my team did on this game and I hope you all enjoy the conclusion to it.

[h3]As a reminder for what we've added to the game:[/h3]
[list]
[*] More music, added 5 more songs made by our lovely composer Shane, rounding the soundtrack to include 12 songs which can be listened to in full in-game with the music player.
[*] More art, in addition to the more than 20 CGs I added, I also added more BGs which can be viewed in-game in the art gallery, extras sprites for some characters, and a secret friend did some amazing cutins for the endings for us.
[*] Ryan wrote an extra 10K words bringing the game to 21K words and 12 endings that all work together to unweave the narrative and reveal a little more about what is actually happening.
[/list]

I have plans for the future of SiaA depending on sales as I would love to add voice acting and more interactions, but that's for the future! For now it's a count down to the release of the game.

Thanks for everyone's support,

Mattie (Demeru)
